title: Measuring algorithmic interpretability: A human-learning-based framework and the corresponding cognitive complexity score
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not present a benchmark and does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes a theoretical framework for measuring the cognitive complexity and interpretability of algorithms.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of the research.
